    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    AddMovieController
    Controller class for adding a movie to the application.
    AdminMenuController
    Controller class for the admin menu.
    App
    Main application class for the JavaFX cinema center application.
    CancelletionsController
    Controller class for managing invoice cancellations.
    CardClickListener
    Interface to define a click listener for handling card interactions.
    cashierParent
    The `cashierParent` class provides a static reference to the `CashierSceneController`.
    CashierSceneController
    Controller class for handling cashier-related functionalities and UI transitions in the cinema system.
    CashierStage1Controller
    Controller class for the Cashier Stage 1 scene in the application.
    CashierStage2Controller
    Controller class for handling the second stage of the cashier interface, which allows the user to select the movie session, including the day, time, hall, and available seats.
    CashierStage4Controller
    The CashierStage4Controller class manages the cashier interface, handling interactions with the product grid, ticket grid, and user inputs.
    CashierStage5Controller
    Controller class for managing cashier operations during the final stage of the purchase process.
    currentUser
    The currentUser class represents the current user's information in the application.
    Employee
    Represents an employee entity within the company.
    EmployeesController
    Employees Controller class is used for manageing employees and their details for manager scene.
    FinanceInformationController
    Finance information controller is for editing ticket price and discount amount also seeing total tax and revenue.
    GenreSelectionController
    The GenreSelectionController class handles the genre selection process for a movie application.
    InventoryController
    Inventory controller for both cashier and manager and different functionalities based on role.
    Invoice
    Invoice entity Represents an invoice with details about a purchase.
    LoginController
    LoginController for loading fxml based on role
    ManagerParent
    A utility class to manage a shared instance of ManagerSceneController.
    ManagerSceneController
    Controller class for handling manager methods This class is responsible for update inventory, employee and see financial stuff
    Movie
    Movie entity Represents a movie with details such as its ID, name, release year, genre, summary, and poster image.
    MovieController
    Controller class for handling movie-related actions and displaying movie data.
    movieDetailsController
    Controller class responsible for displaying movie details in the movie details view.
    MovieListener
    Interface to define a listener for handling movie-related interactions.
    MoviesTabController
    The MoviesTabController class handles the UI interactions and logic for managing movies in a movie management system.
    PriceModifier
    PriceModifier entity Represents a price modifier that can adjust pricing values.
    Product
     
    ProductController
    Controller class for handling product-related actions and displaying product data.
    ScheduleController
    Controller class that manages the schedule of movie sessions.
    seatPlanController
    Controller class responsible for managing the seat selection functionality for a movie session.
    Session
    Session entity Represents a session for a movie screening.
    SlidingSubSceneController
    Controller for handling the sliding subscene that displays the shopping cart.
    StaticSelection
    A utility class that provides static references to various application-level data and selections, such as the selected movie, session details, seat selection, products, and customer information.
